name: finetuned-phase2
architecture: DenseNet121 (ImageNet pretrained) -> GlobalAveragePooling2D -> Dropout -> Dense(14, activation='sigmoid') (top 15 backbone layers unfrozen)
preprocessing: 1. Load PNG as grayscale. 2. Apply CLAHE (clipLimit=2.0, tileGridSize=(8,8)). 3. Resize to 224x224. 4. Replicate grayscale channel to 3 channels (RGB). 5. Apply tf.keras.applications.densenet.preprocess_input (torch-style: scale to [0,1], normalize by ImageNet per-channel mean/std).
notes: HONEST FINDING: fine-tuning did NOT meaningfully improve over v1 (macro AUC 0.699 vs v1's 0.699 - within noise). Two configurations tested (30 and 15 unfrozen layers); both showed overfitting after epoch 1. Kept for documentation/comparison purposes. RECOMMENDATION: use v1 or v3, not v2, for actual deployment.
